summary_en: 4,723 Series 2 Type 7 preferred shares to be acquired on 2026/08/17 at ¥503,427.40/share (¥2.378B cap) via agreed-upon repurchase from all eligible holders. Acquisition precedes planned share-transfer merger establishing joint holding company in April 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares of Series 2 Type 7 Preferred Shares (Acquisition of Treasury Shares Based on the Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On 2026/06/23, The Chiba Kogyo Bank announced a definitive buyback of Series 2 Type 7 preferred shares, part of a broader capital restructuring tied to a planned share-transfer merger. The bank and Chiba Bank will form a joint holding company, Chiba Financial Group, effective 2027/04/01. In advance of that transaction, the bank will repurchase issued preferred shares of three series (Series 2, Series 2 Type 6, and Series 2 Type 7) between 2026/07/01 and 2027/01/31. The Series 2 Type 7 preferred shares, held by the largest number of shareholders among the preferred issuances, will be acquired first. The bank determined on 2026/06/23 to acquire all 4,723 outstanding Series 2 Type 7 preferred shares (excluding treasury holdings) at a fixed price of ¥503,427.40 per share, totalling ¥2.378 billion (cap), settled on 2026/08/17. The acquisition price comprises the ¥500,000 paid-in amount per share plus accrued preferred coupon calculated from 2026/04/01 to settlement date (at ¥9,000 per share annual coupon). This repurchase is part of a capital management plan to ensure an 8%+ regulatory capital ratio following the merger while supporting both banks through capital injections via the new holding company.
